text: The best dictation and voice-to-text app/keyboard that I have ever used. Congratulations! I also use this on my Windows computer. I paid for the Pro license with gusto.Although it's still not licensed to use on my MacBook for work, most of the messages I dictate here are on my cell phone, and I just edit them on my computer if I need to send something more extensive. I hope you guys keep up the good quality. We need to get this app more out in the world!
